zh-CN.name: 复古未来主义
zh-CN.description: 借用过去对未来的视觉想象，例如复古仪表、几何轮廓或金属意象，再结合当前的界面任务。它没有唯一固定的年代、配色或实现库。
use_when: 产品叙事与技术想象或怀旧主题有关。
可用少量素材表达明确视觉方向。
avoid_when: 装饰仪表不应冒充真实数据或控制状态。
不要复制老系统的低可读性与隐蔽操作。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 选择一致的复古未来意象用于主视觉和辅助装饰；现代任务使用明确标签、可靠反馈和清楚导航；区分装饰仪表与真实指标，让窄屏保留必要功能而减少装饰。

en.name: Retro-Futurism
en.description: A visual direction drawing on past visions of the future, such as retro instruments, geometric silhouettes or metallic imagery, while serving current interface tasks. It has no single required era, palette or implementation library.
use_when: The product story relates to technology imagination or nostalgia.
A selective set of motifs can express the visual direction.
avoid_when: Decorative instruments must not imply real data or control states.
Do not reproduce poor legibility or hidden controls from old systems.
en.prompt_template: Use a coherent retro-futuristic motif set in key visuals and supporting decoration. Keep present-day tasks clearly labeled with dependable feedback and navigation. Distinguish decorative instruments from real metrics and reduce decoration on narrow screens.
